item.title: A slice of sweetness coming your way at Pepperell pie sale
item.description: PEPPERELL — The Friends of the Lawrence Library will host their ever-so-sweet Annual Pie Sale from 11:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. on Saturday, Feb. 7, at the Lawrence Library, 15 Main St. After selling more than 80 pies in 2025, the event will once again feature a wide variety of homemade offerings, including traditional dessert pies, quiches and pizza pies.
